name: Futanari Mura ~Futanari Kaizou Acme Jigoku~
original_name: ふたなり村～ふたなり改造アクメ地獄～
source:
She arrived alone, having lost her way. The unpopular little village seemed like a good place to rest.
But when they saw the thing between her legs that no girl should have, the villagers went berserk.

This place... It's full of of hermaphrodite-loving sex maniacs! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118627.html]DLsite English[/url]]
